tools.name: search_robots
tools.description: Find robots by name, maker or kind of robot. Returns each robot's reference for the other tools, and how many specs we hold for it.

tools.name: find_robots
tools.description: Filter robots by published figures, e.g. payload at least 20 kg and reach at least 1300 mm, optionally within a category or maker, sorted by a figure. Only robots that publish every filtered figure can match; the answer says, per figure, how many robots in scope publish it, so a short list is never

tools.name: get_robot
tools.description: Everything we hold on one robot: each spec in its canonical unit, the value as the maker published it, and the document it came from.

tools.name: compare_robots
tools.description: Two to four robots side by side, one row per figure any of them publishes. A robot that doesn't publish a figure shows null (unknown).

tools.name: list_attributes
tools.description: The figures we record (the keys find_robots filters on), with canonical units, allowed values, and how many robots publish each. Give a category to see only the figures that apply to it.

tools.name: lookup_error_code
tools.description: What a robot maker's error code means: its title, the likely causes the maker lists, and a link to the page of the maker's document. Currently Universal Robots and ABB.

tools.name: find_parts
tools.description: Spare parts that fit a robot, each with the part number, the document that says it fits (the maker's catalogue or manual, or an authorised seller), and the series it is scoped to.
